title: Tesla Growth Simulator
why: Tesla's growth depends on factories, battery cells, workers and delivery logistics scaling together, and it has hit production ramp limits before. This tool tests whether a sales target is possible and what it would cost to get there.
problem: Management wants to increase sales by 20% but does not know whether existing employees, inventory, production capacity and logistics can support the additional demand. Build an AI scenario-analysis system that simulates business consequences of different strategic decisions.
data_note: One region's quarterly plan: 4 assembly lines, battery supply, workforce, delivery centres and cost base (sample data).

steps.detail: Demand, line capacity, labour hours, battery cells, delivery slots, costs
Demand needs cars built, cars need labour and cells, cars need delivery slots
Sales growth, shifts, new line, battery contract, price, delivery partners
2,000 runs with uncertain demand, yield, productivity and supply
Which resource runs out first in each run
Try every combination of levers, keep the cheapest that hits the target 80% of the time
Revenue, cost, margin and investment per scenario

questions: Can we hit +20% with what we have today?
What is the cheapest way to reach the target?
What if we cut prices by 5% instead?
Which constraint should we fix first?
author: K Mohan Kumar
